_schema.what: Named events with dates, for CHRONOLOGY (verify/chronology.py). A claim that names one of these references its date. Load-bearing on whether claims publish, so it carries the candidate-table discipline: a citable primary-source URL (verified by fetch, never typed from memory -- null until one is), and reviewed_by (null until a person checks the row).
_schema.rule: Any date a registry can answer is NOT in this table. The Lancet's 2010 retraction and the 2004 partial retraction ('retraction of an interpretation') of Wakefield 1998 resolve from Crossref update-to / Europe PMC commentCorrectionList on the source itself (verify/status.py) and are matched by verify/chronology.named_events from the registry's events, not from here.

columns.label: the event
columns.phrases: what a claim says when it names this event (case-insensitive substrings)
columns.url: primary source, verified by fetch, or null

_schema.register: Every row is listed in docs/signal-corpus-freeze.md so a wrong date is traceable.
